# Standings after r004: sequences the minds witnessed

*Generated by `harness/seq/evidence_view.py`, built without the likelihood model. Every adjacent step of every sequence is the middle of a triple that at least two answers put in that order. None-answers don't count against an ordering. Where an end has several witnessed continuations, the sequence forks. 2627 triples witnessed by at least one family (or by all answers pooled); 379 sequences after folding restatements; 130 stable (two or more families measured, U ≥ 0.8). A triple counts if ANY family witnesses it, so sequences only some families see are shown, with their support; nothing is dropped for not being universal.*

**Family columns:** the share of the sequence's consecutive triples witnessed using only that family's answers. `–` means unmeasured. **Every step witnessed by:** the families whose own answers witness all of it. **Branch at:** glyphs it shares with another sequence in this view.
